title: Canada › Bike › Film In
intro: The film in (story/films/snowman.ts): the snowy park under the castle hotel, flags and lanterns, nobody about.

flags.text: My friend Monty is the biggest moose in Canada!
He's having his bath at the waterfall, way down there.
The fastest way down is my bike. Hold on!
